Heybike is once again dominating our daily Green Deals edition with another pair of exclusive deals for our readers, but this time on newer models. You can now score the first-ever $500 savings on the Hybrid Longest Range Commuter e-bike at a new $1,199 low , or jump on the 45-pound Venus Lightweight Cruiser e-bike at a new $999 low . We’ve also got EcoFlow’s October EcoCredits Madness flash sale running through the weekend, with power station deals like the 2,048Wh DELTA 3 Max bundled with 2x 220W solar panels at $1,379 (second-lowest of the year), among others. There’s also the continuing annual low on Greenworks’ 3,000 PSI electric pressure washer, and more waiting for you below. Don’t forget about yesterday’s hangover deals at the bottom of the page, which included the new lows on Heybike’s budget-friendly Mars 2.5 and Ranger S 2.0 e-bikes, a Segway E2 Pro e-scooter deal, and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Our readers can score an exclusive $500 off Heybike’s 100-mile Hybrid commuter e-bike at a new $1,199 low (First discount)
Following the two exclusive deals to new lows on Heybike’s Mars 2.5 and Ranger S 2.0 e-bikes, and coming alongside the new exclusive Venus e-bike low , the brand is offering our readers an exclusive chance at the very first discount on its Hybrid Longest Range Commuter e-bike to $1,199 shipped , after using the code 9T5T500 at checkout. While this 2026 model hit the market back in March, it hasn’t seen any discounts until now. With our exclusive savings code, not only are you getting the very first chance at cash savings on the bike, but it totals $500 being cut from the tag for a new all-time low that is far more than we typically see for a first-time deal.
You can learn all about this Hybird Commuter e-bike’s features here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Heybike’s 45-pound Venus lightweight commuter e-bike covers up to 85 miles at a new exclusive $999 low ($500 off)
Heybike is really giving 9to5Toys readers a ton of great savings right now, with exclusive new low prices on its Hybrid 100-mile e-bike (first discount), as well as the Mars 2.5 and Ranger S 2.0 e-bikes. The deals don’t end there, as the brand is also offering our readers exclusive savings on its Venus Lightweight Commuter and Getaway Cruiser e-bike down at $999 shipped , once you use the code 9T5T500 at checkout. This model launched alongside the Hybrid model back in March at $1,999 in full, but unlike its sibling, this model started with a discount to $1,499 that soon became its standard MSRP, with only bundled FREE gear offered with it ever since. Now, you’ll save an exclusive $500 on it with this deal, landing it at a new all-time low price.
You can learn all about the Venus e-bike’s features broken down for you here .
EcoFlow EcoCredits flash sale drops DELTA 3 Max 440W solar bundle to $1,379 ($220 off), more
EcoFlow is expanding its Halloween Sale lineup with a 4-day EcoCredits Monthly Madness flash sale that includes four power station units alongside two EcoCredit deals. Aside from those point purchases, things start with the popular DELTA 3 Max 2,048Wh Portable Power Station with 2x 220W solar panels down at $1,379 shipped (price shown in cart), which cannot benefit from the overall sale’s extra savings code . Down from $1,599, this bundle beats out Amazon where you’d have to get the power station and a single panel while buying a second panel seapartely for $1,598. In 2026, we’ve only seen this rate beaten by discounts in March and June, which both had short-term savings events that saw it available at $1,228. You’re getting the next-best price here with $220 cut from the tag. Head below to browse the lineup of flash deals while it lasts through the weekend.
***Note: Don’t be caught off guard by the price you see on these station’s pages, as there are additional savings taken off to the prices you see below once they are in your cart.
